name: qdi-stacking-single
description: Qualified dividends and long-term capital gains stacked on ordinary income: fills the 0% band (to $48,350) then spills into 15%, with the ordinary slice taxed on the single rate schedule. The engine's stacking must reproduce the Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet line by line.

source.publication: Instructions for Form 1040 (2025), Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet-Line 16
source.pin: Worksheet line 6: $48,350 if single (top of the 0% band); line 13: $533,400 if single (top of the 15% band); line 22 taxes the ordinary slice on the Tax Table / Tax Computation Worksheet.

derivation: Total income = 30,000 wages + 30,000 qualified dividends + 20,000 LTCG = $80,000; AGI $80,000.
QDIVCG worksheet: line 4 (qualified dividends + LTCG, no Schedule D) = $50,000; line 5 (ordinary taxable) = 64,250 - 50,000 = $14,250.
Line 6 = $48,350 (single); line 9 (0% band amount) = min(48,350, 64,250) - 14,250 = $34,100 taxed at 0%.
Total tax = 1,471.50 + 2,385.00 = $3,856.50. NIIT: MAGI 80,000 < 200,000 single threshold (Instructions for Form 8960 (2025)) = $0.
